entries.en: to flee; to run away, go off
entries.notes: 词头中段「estando se」转写存疑、汉字中字[疑:迌/近]未定；据L Huir与M音写chaù-cú（走…去）定「走开/逃走」义

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕汉字与音写为「十匹」（布帛十正，马尼拉贸易计量），与西语词头 huir「奔逃」不合
entries.en: doubtful: characters and romanization read 'sip-pit' = ten bolts/pieces (of cloth), a Manila trade measure; conflicts with Spanish headword huir 'to flee'
entries.notes: H 十[疑:正/疋]、M sip-pit 与 L huir 语义相抵，疑词头串行错位；两读并记，不强行定夺

entries.zh: 逃闪；闪避躲开（对人闪避、不与照面）
entries.en: to dodge, evade; to give someone the slip, keep out of anyone's way

entries.zh: 走闪；逃避差事（躲开劳役活计）
entries.en: to shirk, dodge work or a task; to slip away from labor
entries.notes: M 第二音节声调污損难辨（T99）；字义据 H「走閃」与 L「huir el cuerpo al trabajo」定躲差逃役义

entries.en: to dodge aside, get out of the way
entries.notes: M 声调污損难辨（T99）；字义据 H「閃開」与 L「huir el cuerpo」定闪避让开义

entries.zh: 闪僻；闪避开躲（躲僻一旁、不与人遇）
entries.en: to sidestep, keep aloof, dodge out of sight
entries.notes: M 两音节声调均污損难辨（T99）；据 H「閃僻」与 L「huir el cuerpo」定躲闪退避义

entries.zh: 急速奔逃（据西语词头 huir presto）；汉字「相○走」未定，或为相偕逃走
entries.en: to flee swiftly (Sp. huir presto); Chinese form uncertain, possibly 'to run away together'
entries.notes: L 中段「ⁿimp e huiu」难解、H 中字[疑:乙/之]、M 前两音节声调污損（T99）；仅据核心词定急逃义

entries.zh: 逃窜；为藏匿而逃（逃往躲藏）
entries.en: to flee and scurry into hiding; to run away so as to hide oneself
to flee and evade, escape so as to avoid
to flee away, run off and escape

entries.zh: 逃去闪避（末字存疑，音写 siam 指向「闪」）
entries.en: to flee away dodging; final character uncertain (romanization points to 'dodge')
entries.notes: H 末字[疑:珆/班]、M 末音节声调污損（T99）；据 M 音写暂核「闪」，置信降级

entries.en: to flee away to a secluded spot, keep out of the way
entries.notes: M 第二音节声调污損难辨（T99）；据 H「逃僻」与 L「esconder se」定避匿义

entries.zh: 脱脚走脱（首字存疑）；以脱身之计溜走
entries.en: to slip away, make off (by a trick); first character doubtful
entries.notes: L 中段「engañando vtal ga…」转写破碎、H 首字[疑:縭/繼]、M 声调污損（T99）；据西语「y se escapar」与 M hva-ka-tsáu 定脱脚溜走义

entries.en: to break away, slip away from; to escape, get free of
to slip away and flee, make one's escape
to slip away, extricate oneself, make good one's escape

entries.zh: 脱手；脱出手中（人脱手溜走；兼指货物出手脱售，马尼拉贸易语境）
entries.en: to slip out of one's hands, get away; also (of goods) to be sold off, disposed of
entries.notes: 「脱手」兼脱逃与货物出手二义，据词头 escabullirse 以前者为主，兼记贸易义

entries.en: to slip away and go off, make off

entries.zh: 私奔；私自逃走（多指女子随人私逃）
entries.en: to elope, run away secretly; to flee in secret
